observations: body: the line numbers 5 and 10 stand in the left margin, 15, 20 and 25 left of the figure, 30 to 40 in the left margin again; the locator «p. 138.» (L26) stands in the right margin, right of the column beside the figure.

body: the figure stands at the left of lines 13 to 28, which are set beside it in a narrow measure. It is redrawn from measurements of the print: its two circles, the arc DLB (an arc of a circle through B and D) and its four straight lines are least-squares fits to the printed ink, and its thirteen letters (bold italic capitals) and the four words MERIDIES, ORIENS, OCCIDENS and SEPTENTRIONES (bold sans-serif capitals) stand where they are printed. In the print the circle ABCD is broken above G, its lower part set a little to the right of the upper; the redrawing gives the whole circle. In OCCIDENS the E is printed broken.
body L10: «lineā rectā» are printed with a macron over the final a of both words.
body L12: the letter of the reference (f) is bold italic.

body L32, L34-L38: the words «scilicet initium Scorpionis», «et gradum cum Luna culminantem», «arcus HG altitudo gradus cum quo Luna culminat, super horizontem; et» and «arcus DH arcum eclipticae inter initium Librae et gradum cum Luna culminantem;» are set in italic; after note 2 they are to be deleted.
body L18: a speck hangs under the n of «zontis»; the letter is an n.
body L37: a dot stands over the u of the italic «arcus» before «DH»; it is not an accent.
notes_left L4: the letter «f» of «adn. f» is bold italic.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
